info.name: Anypoint Platform Logs
info.description:
Pull application logs from Anypoint Platform via the public APIs. Walks through OAuth client_credentials, environment/deployment/spec discovery, log search with filters, cursor-based pagination, and raw log file download. Mirrors the steps in 'How to get application logs using the Anypoint Platform APIs.docx'.

Usage:
1. Open the collection's Variables tab and fill client_id, client_secret, organization_id, and host.
2. Run '1 - Get access token' first; the test script auto-populates {{access_token}}.
3. Run the discovery requests (2, 3, 4) and copy each returned id into the matching collection variable.
4. Set startTime/endTime (epoch ms, UTC) on the search request, then run it. For pagination, copy the last record's docId into the afterDocId param of '7 - Search logs (next page)'.

exec: // Auto-capture the access token into the collection variable so subsequent
// requests can reference {{access_token}} without manual copy/paste.

request.description: OAuth 2.0 client_credentials grant. Returns an access_token valid for ~1 hour. The Tests tab auto-stores the token in the {{access_token}} collection variable.
Lists every environment in the org. Copy the id of the target environment into the {{environment_id}} collection variable.
Lists deployments (running applications) in the chosen environment. Copy the id of the target application into the {{deployment_id}} collection variable.
Returns deployment details including the replicas array. Each replica reports the spec it is running. Copy replicas[0].specId into the {{spec_id}} collection variable.

query.description: Page size, max 1000. Default is 10, so always set this explicitly.
Inclusive start of time window, epoch milliseconds UTC (13 digits).
Inclusive end of time window, epoch milliseconds UTC (13 digits).
false = oldest first; recommended when paginating forward.
Repeat for multiple levels. Valid: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR.

request.description: Paginated log search. Each filter MUST be its own query parameter — do NOT pack them into a JSON object inside ?search=... (that parameter is free-text only and would silently cap results to 10). Replace the example startTime/endTime with your own epoch-ms values.

query.description: docId of the last record in the previous page. Repeat until a page returns fewer than 1000 records.

request.description: Same query as the first-page request, plus afterDocId set to the docId of the last record from the prior page. Repeat until a response has strictly fewer than {{length}} records — that is the safe end-of-stream signal.
Plaintext download of the raw log file the runtime wrote (every level, every line). To persist locally: in Postman use Save Response > Save to a file.

variable.description: Anypoint control-plane host. EU=eu1.anypoint.mulesoft.com, US=anypoint.mulesoft.com. Tokens are region-bound.
Connected App Client ID (from your Anypoint admin).
Connected App Client Secret (from your Anypoint admin). Treat as a password.
Filled automatically by '1 - Get access token' (its Tests script). Lifetime ~1 hour.
Environment UUID; populate from '2 - List environments'.
Deployment (application) UUID; populate from '3 - List deployments'.
Spec UUID for the running revision; populate from '4 - Get deployment'.
